top_story.title: Nvidia’s Asian Suppliers Rally as Jensen Huang Returns as CEO: SK Hynix Jumps 8%, SoftBank Shares Rise in Tokyo
top_story.summary: Jensen Huang‘s return as chief executive of Nvidia Corp. (NASDAQ:NVDA) sent shares of its Asian partners and suppliers sharply higher on Tuesday. Asian Markets Rally as US Futures Hold Gains S&P 500 futures edged up 14.25 points, or 0.20%, to 7,268.75 as of around 7:42 p.m. EST on Monday. The Nasdaq 100 futures climbed 1,751.75 points, or 6.97%, to 26,878.25, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average futures rose 1,447.98 points, or 3%, to 49,595.31.
